}}'''Hamal''' is a blacksmith of the [[Aiel]].

==Appearance==
He is a big man.

==History==
He is a blacksmith of the [[Moshaine]] sept of the [[Shaido]] clan.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Hamal}}

==Activities==
After the Moshaine Aiel step out of the gateway, they are quickly discovered by a larger force comprised of [[Reyn]] Aiel and an army of wetlanders (presumably Rand's supporters). Their sept chief, [[Maeric]] gives Hamal the task of pressing the red spot on the [[nar'baha]] in the hope that he can save some of their sept.

His fate is unknown. As a blacksmith, he will not be attacked by any Aiel, but the opposing army also included wetlanders who would have no such restrictions. They would be unlikely to kill a group that was not hostile, however.
